subject: Intercompany credit posted to wrong business unit - request to reapply
messages:
From: NovaHealth AP <ap@novahealth.com>
To: alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com
Cc: lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com
Date: Sat, 29 May 2027 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Payment posted 05/28 - intercompany credit landed on wrong BU

Hi Alex,

We posted a bulk payment to Redwood yesterday (05/28) for invoices across two business units. Our bank confirms the total amount cleared, but NovaHealth's internal reconciliation shows an intercompany credit of $27,300 was applied to Redwood BU "Redwood Corporate" by your bank instead of Redwood BU "Redwood Gov". That is creating a balance mismatch on our statement.

Attached is the remittance stub (remittance_20270528.pdf) and a quick screenshot from our AR system. Can you confirm how the credit was applied on your side and whether you can re-allocate it to the correct BU or provide a journal/credit note to let our team complete the reconciliation?

We need confirmation for our auditors by COB Monday (06/01). Please include the originating bank trace if that helps.

Thanks,

Trevor Mills
Senior AP Lead
NovaHealth

Attachment: remittance_20270528.pdf (PDF, 1 page - payment detail)

From: alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com
To: NovaHealth AP <ap@novahealth.com>
Cc: lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com, marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com
Date: Sat, 29 May 2027 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Payment posted 05/28 - intercompany credit landed on wrong BU

Hi Trevor — thanks for the heads up and for the remittance.

We're looking into allocation on our side. Quick requests to speed this up:
- Can you attach the bank trace (ACH/ABA or swift) showing the originating instruction ID?
- Which Redwood invoice numbers (or your internal invoice refs) should the $27,300 be applied to under Redwood Gov?

I'm looping in Lauren (Finance Ops) and Marcus (Billing) to check internal posting logs; we'll pull the deposit details and snapshot the allocation. If it requires a manual journal or credit note we will propose the exact accounting entries and timing.

I'll update you by EOD Sunday (05/30).

Cheers,
Alex Martinez
Account Executive, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0149

From: NovaHealth AP <ap@novahealth.com>

Cc: lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com
Date: Sun, 30 May 2027 09:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Payment posted 05/28 - intercompany credit landed on wrong BU

Hi Alex,

Thanks — attached is the bank trace CSV (bank_trace_20270528.csv). The payment reference in the trace is NH-20270528-5772 and shows two contra-legs: $120,000 (invoice set A) and $27,300 (intercompany credit). Our AP system flagged that the smaller leg should have been applied to Redwood Gov (GL 55-700), not Redwood Corporate (GL 12-300).

For your reference, the impacted internal refs are: NH-INV-20270405, NH-INV-20270412 (these map to Redwood Gov invoices).

We'd prefer a re-application on Redwood's side (journal + remittance note) rather than voiding and reissuing the whole payment if possible. Our auditors need the remediation memo + timestamp.

Trevor

Attachment: bank_trace_20270528.csv (CSV, 3 rows)

Date: Sun, 30 May 2027 16:47:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Payment posted 05/28 - intercompany credit landed on wrong BU

Hi Trevor / Alex — quick status and proposed remediation.

Thanks for the trace file — Marcus pulled the deposit log and confirmed the clearing entry on 2027-05-28 shows a single lockbox deposit with two ledger tags; our automated posting pipeline defaulted to the primary BU (Redwood Corporate) for the $27,300 leg because the incoming file omitted the secondary tag (we use tag 2 for intercompany).

Proposed fix (minimal disruption):
1) Redwood will post a contra-journal dated 2027-05-31 to move $27,300 from Redwood Corporate (GL 12-300) to Redwood Gov (GL 55-700) and create a short remediation memo referencing NH-20270528-5772.
2) We'll send a formal remittance credit note (CreditNote-RW-20270531.pdf) and the accounting entry details to NovaHealth AP so your team can update the AR records.
3) Expected completion: journal posted and note emailed by 2027-05-31 COB PST.

Could you confirm that re-application via our contra-journal is acceptable to NovaHealth auditors? If you need a different document format (signed memo vs. system journal extract) let us know now so we can include it.

Marcus — once Trevor confirms, please schedule the journal and attach a screenshot of the posting (redwood_allocation_snapshot_20270529.png) to the confirmation email.

Thanks,
Lauren Bishop
Finance Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com | +1 (650) 555-0217
